1_cftc_cot_socrata_api.python_example:
import requests
import pandas as pd

COT_LEGACY_URL = 'https://publicreporting.cftc.gov/resource/6dca-aqww.json'
COT_DISAGG_URL = 'https://publicreporting.cftc.gov/resource/72hh-3qpy.json'

COMMODITY_CODES = {
    'GOLD': '088691', 'SILVER': '084691', 'COPPER': '085692',
    'CRUDE_OIL': '067651', 'NATURAL_GAS': '023651',
    'CORN': '002602', 'WHEAT': '001602', 'SOYBEANS': '005602',
    'COFFEE': '083731', 'SUGAR': '080732', 'COTTON': '033661'
}

def fetch_cot_legacy(commodity_code, limit=52):
    params = {
        '$where': f"cftc_contract_market_code='{commodity_code}'",
        '$order': 'as_of_date_in_form_yymmdd DESC',
        '$limit': limit
    }
    r = requests.get(COT_LEGACY_URL, params=params, timeout=30)
    r.raise_for_status()
    data = r.json()
    df = pd.DataFrame(data)
    return df

def fetch_cot_disaggregated(commodity_code, limit=52):
    params = {
        '$where': f"cftc_contract_market_code='{commodity_code}'",
        '$order': 'as_of_date_in_form_yymmdd DESC',
        '$limit': limit
    }
    r = requests.get(COT_DISAGG_URL, params=params, timeout=30)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return pd.DataFrame(r.json())

def compute_net_positioning(df):
    df['net_speculative'] = df['noncomm_positions_long_all'].astype(float) - df['noncomm_positions_short_all'].astype(float)
    df['net_commercial'] = df['comm_positions_long_all'].astype(float) - df['comm_positions_short_all'].astype(float)
    df['spec_long_pct'] = df['pct_of_oi_noncomm_long_all'].astype(float)
    df['spec_short_pct'] = df['pct_of_oi_noncomm_short_all'].astype(float)
    return df

# Fetch all commodities
for name, code in COMMODITY_CODES.items():
    df = fetch_cot_legacy(code, limit=4)
    df = compute_net_positioning(df)
    latest = df.iloc[0]
    print(f"{name}: Net Spec={latest['net_speculative']:.0f}, Net Comm={latest['net_commercial']:.0f}")

2_cftc_bulk_csv_download.name: CFTC Historical Compressed CSV Files
2_cftc_bulk_csv_download.description: Bulk annual ZIP files containing full year COT data. Best for backtesting and historical analysis.
2_cftc_bulk_csv_download.python_example:
import requests, zipfile, io, pandas as pd

def download_cot_bulk(year=2026):
    url = f'https://www.cftc.gov/files/dea/history/deacot{year}.zip'
    r = requests.get(url, timeout=60)
    r.raise_for_status()
    z = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content))
    csv_name = z.namelist()[0]
    df = pd.read_csv(z.open(csv_name))
    return df

df = download_cot_bulk(2026)
gold = df[df['CFTC Contract Market Code'] == '088691']
print(gold[['As of Date in Form YYMMDD', 'Open Interest (All)', 'Noncommercial Positions-Long (All)', 'Noncommercial Positions-Short (All)']].head())

diy_seasonal_calculation.description: Build your own seasonal index from yfinance historical data
diy_seasonal_calculation.python_example:
import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def calculate_seasonal_pattern(symbol, years=15):
    data = yf.download(symbol, period=f'{years}y', interval='1d')
    data['month'] = data.index.month
    data['day_of_year'] = data.index.dayofyear
    data['pct_change'] = data['Close'].pct_change()
    
    # Monthly seasonal pattern
    monthly = data.groupby('month')['pct_change'].agg(['mean', 'std', 'count'])
    monthly['win_rate'] = data.groupby('month')['pct_change'].apply(lambda x: (x > 0).mean())
    monthly.columns = ['avg_return', 'volatility', 'observations', 'win_rate']
    return monthly

for name, sym in {'GOLD': 'GC=F', 'CRUDE_OIL': 'CL=F', 'CORN': 'ZC=F'}.items():
    print(f'\n=== {name} Seasonal Pattern ===')
    pattern = calculate_seasonal_pattern(sym)
    print(pattern.round(4))
